title: Sajjad De Athru Bazaar’ch Aakay Rang Badla Gaye
body:
Jado Shaur Machaya, Haye Shaamiyon Nay
Sang Barsao, Aj Shaam Day Qaidi Aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Rhondi Si Sakina, Naam Lay Lay Kay
Asghar Da Shaam Sawairay
Yaad Aundiyan Pyaasa,
Haye Veer Diyan,
Rhondi Margayi,
Enu Dukh Baysheer Dekha Gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ummat Jo Pawa Ay, Ali Abad Nu
Zanjeer Beemar Samajh Kay,
Sir-o-Nangean Si Phupiyan,
Haye Ron Paiyaan,
Dukh Safran Day,
Sajjad Di Kamar Jhuka Gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughara Tay Sakina, Jag Duniya Tay
Kinj Di Kismat Hay Payi
Ik Behn Nu Mari
Haye Shaam Huwee
Ik Nu Kaliyan,
Watna Tay Chor Bhira Gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Diyan Jaiyaan, Shaam Vichalay
Ro Ro Kay Mangan Ridawan,
Raye Khutbay Jo Pardh Di,
Haye Aun Di Maa,
Vich Bazaaran,
Beemar Nu Khoon Rawa Gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Rab Janay, Zahra Dey Naal
Si Ghair Ummat Nu Keda,
Pehlo Chadran Lutiyan,
Haye Zaliman Nay,
Vich Karbal Day,
Fir Khaimayan Nu Aag Laa Gaye
